name: cli
title_zh: 一个命令行接管 Google 全家桶的官方 CLI
tagline_zh: Drive、Gmail、日历、表格、文档、Chat、Admin…… 不用再记七八个 API 端点。一个工具。
tagline_en: One CLI to rule all Google Workspace APIs — Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Chat, Admin. Auto-generated.
desc_en: Google Workspace CLI — one command-line tool for Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Chat, Admin, and more. Dynamically built from Google Discovery Service. Includes AI agent skills.
why_zh: 不是手写封装，而是从 Google Discovery Service 动态生成——API 更新它跟着。
why_en: Not hand-wrapped — dynamically generated from Google Discovery Service, so it tracks API changes automatically. Official Google.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Google Workspace 官方 API，不含 GCP、YouTube 等非 Workspace 服务。
limit_en: Only Google Workspace official APIs — no GCP, YouTube, etc. Requires Node.js 18+ and a Google Cloud project for OAuth. CLI only, no GUI or data.
